summary: Avino Silver & Gold Mines Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K attaching an October 15, 2026 press release reporting Q3 2026 production results, not a special-situation transaction. Output totaled 303,189 silver oz, 1,732 gold oz and 1.1 million copper lbs, or 582,836 silver-equivalent oz, with La Preciosa development production up 5% sequentially to 105,867 AgEq oz and mill throughput of 190,379 tonnes. Management cited over 3,000 metres of La Preciosa development and rates above 450 tonnes per day. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, stake, price or regulatory clock were stated.
